description: Bounded source evidence over one explicit table, shared with --check-source creation gates. Ready is not complete compatibility or loaded-data proof.

checks.message: Different source tables with the same basename may collide during model inference. No table is dropped or renamed automatically.
Metadata visibility is not access for other identities.

nextSteps.message: Inspect the same scoped resource without changing it.

checks.message: Unrecognized layouts remain unknown, not an automatic mode change.
A contiguous metadata/protocol suffix was observed, not an atomic current snapshot.
Reader requirements are distinct from writer requirements.
Primitive metadata only, not source values, precision or service inference.

notChecked: Parquet/table rows, row counts, statistics values and loaded data
data freshness or an atomic snapshot
native service acceptance, complete type mapping and precision
target workspace permissions, capacity and cross-region alignment
model relationships, framing and DAX readiness
SQL security, storage/fallback mode and grants for other identities
checkpoint/sidecar replay and unsupported Delta features

notes: sourceIndex refers to the corresponding --one-lake-table input; arbitrary source names and log data are not echoed. Creation --check-source embeds this report as sourceCheck, fails before POST for any non-ready finding, and cannot be bypassed by --force. Exact duplicate URLs fail offline; potential inferred-name collisions are findings. Native/standalone dry-run is offline; generator dry-run retains existing SQL discovery but skips OneLake probes and creation.

query_examples.description: Inspect source findings without dumping table names or raw metadata.
Review unverified properties before interpreting ready.
